about_the_game:
NARRATIVE.

The Germans knew they would lose the war. In a desperate attempt at victory, they unleashed a hell upon the battlefront that would consume Europe...

You wake up in a zombie infested hotel, the only way out is to descend into pure chaos. As you go from floor to floor slaughtering the undead, you'll go deeper into the trenches of your mind to uncover the truth of the outbreak.

GAMEPLAY.

Absolution of the Dead is a first person narrative zombie survival game where you'll experience a mind-bending descent into the depths of an undead hell. Loot, craft, and upgrade your zombie killing arsenal to exit out alive....

  • Loot the hotel and trenches to find weapons, explosives, equipment.

  • Craft equipment from molotov cocktails, to sticky grenades, to electric traps and claymores.

  • Upgrade your weapons. From rapid fire, incendiary shells and cluster grenades. 

  • Inject serums to increase your zombie killing skillset. From increased health, to improved accuracy, to slowing down time.

  • Uncover and enhance secret experimental weaponry.

  • Discover the unsettling truth of the outbreak as you descend deeper into the hotel by finding notes, recordings and radios.

WEAPONS.

Slaughter the undead by finding and crafting weapons. Revolvers, to double barrel shotguns, to flamethrowers and grenade launchers...and weapons unknown to man. Weapons can be upgraded by equipping attachments at gun benches. Making sure you'll be able to survive the floors as the undead become more and more relentless.

EQUIPMENT.

Exploding and electrifying zombies is the most fun way killing the undead; find parts and materials across the hotel and trenches to craft new equipment such as claymores, nail bombs, electric traps, flashbangs, and more...

SERUMS.

In your descent you'll discover the secret labs of the German army; in the labs remains the experimental serums used to find a cure to the outbreak. Injecting these unknown chemicals will enhance you. From increased strength, slowing down time, to abilities beyond comprehension...

content_descriptors.notes: Killing lots and lots of zombies, with lots and lots of blood.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: i5 9600k or a bit lower spec
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 6GB or a bit lower spec
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: i5 9600k or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 6GB or better
